verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant generates real Honeycomb queries from natural language input. Its official MCP server also lets AI agents query live telemetry and answer questions, exposing query, Board and Canvas tools and handling open-ended prompts like investigating latency. A community user reports using Honeycomb's MCP server with an LLM agent during incidents. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Query Assistant behavior and limits, explicit evidence that charts or visualizations are returned, and independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language-to-query feature itself.
